description: This file defines the Host class interface for device settings management, including power modes, display connections, audio/video ports, and device information.

classes.name: Host
classes.description: Class implementing device host interface with methods for power management, port access, device info, and event listeners.

methods.name: setPowerMode
methods.description: Sets the power mode; currently always returns true.

methods.name: getAvailableSleepModes
methods.description: Returns a list of available sleep modes.

methods.name: addPowerModeListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for power mode changes.

methods.name: removePowerModeChangeListener
methods.description: Removes a power mode change listener.

methods.name: addDisplayConnectionListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for display connection changes.

methods.name: removeDisplayConnectionListener
methods.description: Removes a display connection change listener.

methods.name: getVideoOutputPorts
methods.description: Returns list of video output ports.

methods.name: getAudioOutputPorts
methods.description: Returns list of audio output ports.

methods.name: getVideoOutputPort
methods.description: Returns a reference to a VideoOutputPort by name or id.

methods.name: getAudioOutputPort
methods.description: Returns a reference to an AudioOutputPort by name or id.

methods.name: notifyPowerChange
methods.description: Notifies listeners of a power mode change.

methods.name: getCPUTemperature
methods.description: Returns a fixed CPU temperature value.

methods.name: getSocIDFromSDK
methods.description: Returns the SoC ID from SDK.

methods.name: setAudioAtmosOutputMode
methods.description: Enables or disables Atmos output mode.

methods.name: isHDMIOutPortPresent
methods.description: Checks for HDMI output port presence.
